items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Junior Cobbs come and heard me play one night, and he goes back and tells Hugh Swift about me. So Hugh would have told him to bring me out to rehearsal. I would have to rehearse it with him. And I went right on to work with him.

ctx.x: Were you in the band when Baby played with him for Baby Dogs for a while?

Yeah, yeah, I took a little short boy's place there, and he lost his lip. His lip went bad on him. He couldn't play, and I took him this place. And they featured me maddy good. They featured me a lot there, singing and blowing. I worked there about a year with them, making nice money. I tell you, you ever heard of Junior Cobbs? Oh, yes. He was in the band. He played a lot of different instruments. Yeah, that's him. That's him. Well, he the one come and got me to go with that band. Because I was playing in a…
Well, to get back to those Tiny Parham records, Dick, did you go over that list of which ones? Punch Resort, I remember some of those names. Different ones.
